entities.summary: Margaret Adebisi Sowunmi was a Nigerian botanist and environmental archaeologist. She was Professor of Palynology and Environmental Archaeology at the University of Ibadan. She pioneered the study of environmental archaeology and palaeoethnobotany in Nigeria and was the founder and president of the Palynological Association of Nigeria.
